scope: One ordinary public image job completed through native Candle/CUDA and was persisted in the project library. Same-job API-only readback completed the strict shared asset and served-file assertions without another generation.

provenance.binary_reuse: Verified no non-test Rust or Cargo input changed; intervening changes were scripts, fixtures and the rust-api health serialization test.
provenance.job_backend_contract: Existing backend_label(settings.gpu_id) device identity, unchanged since June 2026; Candle engine identity is independently proven by the adapter and inference events.

asset.visual_inspection: Nonblank teal ceramic teapot on a pale yellow table.

operational_gpu_observation.uuid_proof: Masked CUDA driver enumeration and the actual worker PID's NVIDIA GPU UUID both match physical GPU1.
operational_gpu_observation.metric: GPU1 total device-used memory, including the desktop baseline; sampled peak, not an exact allocator peak

safety.runner_worker_checks: Before launch and every two seconds; no interruption during generation
safety.app_state: Unique owned Windows TEMP directory outside the repository
safety.worker_cleanup: Owned stdin closed, graceful exit code 0
safety.api_cleanup: Only owned API PIDs stopped after the bounded cleanup deadline
safety.api_only_readback: Both tensor backends disabled and CUDA hidden; GET requests only; no worker or rerender

retention: The full receipt, PNG, sidecar and redacted logs remain outside the repository. No model weights, databases, credentials, PNG binaries or raw logs are committed.
boundaries: This is not a calibration campaign, peak-memory bound, anchor-currentness assertion or matrix input.
One plain distilled 1024-square job only; not physical 4K, base, LoRA or enabled prompt-upsampler real-weight coverage.
Earlier prelaunch harness failures remain retained and were not counted as image generations.
The original completed-job receipt retained the caller mismatch; a separately retained API-only continuation passed all final shared assertions without rewriting the original receipt.
